hold_text: This PR edits `.github/workflows/claude-pr-automerge.yml`, which is named in `check_pr_landing.py::LANDING_MACHINERY`, so R12 holds it and that is correct rather than inconvenient: the change alters WHEN auto-merge arms, and letting it self-land would mean the gate approving its own loosening. WHAT A HUMAN SHOULD CHECK, in order of how much it would cost to get wrong. (1) THE NEW `fetch` SHIM IS ON THE PR-CREATE PATH. It implements exactly one method, `rest.pulls.create`, because that is the only call made through `opener` (one site). It is the THIRD try: both `require('@actions/github')` spellings are kept and kept FIRST, so a runtime that can build a real Octokit still does, and `automerge-trigger-guard` C6's source literal survives. If `fetch` is absent it throws, so the existing loud GITHUB_TOKEN fallback is still reached rather than a half-built client being returned. (2) IT COULD OPEN A PR AS THE PAT'S OWNER RATHER THAN AS `github-actions[bot]` — which is the POINT (a bot-opened PR fires no `pull_request` event and gets no checks), and is also the one thing a human may want to weigh, since it changes who the PR is attributed to. (3) WHETHER `BRANCH_PROTECTION_TOKEN` CARRIES PULL-REQUEST WRITE SCOPE IS STILL UNESTABLISHED and cannot be read from a session. The shim throws an error carrying `.status`, shaped like an Octokit error, precisely so the workflow's EXISTING 403 fallback keeps working: on a 403 it retries under GITHUB_TOKEN, sets `openerKind = 'github_token'`, and the arming gate then REFUSES. So the failure mode is 'PR opened, not armed', loudly — never a silent merge. (4) THE GATE CHANGE IS STRICTLY SUBTRACTIVE. `opener_cannot_attach` only ever WITHHOLDS arming; nothing new can merge because of it. An absent `opener_kind` grades exactly as before, so no other caller is stranded. ⚠️ IT IS NOT A BLANKET REFUSAL, AND THAT IS THE RISK THIS PR IS MOST CAREFUL ABOUT: keying the gate on REQUIRED checks instead would have refused every self-landing PR in the repo, because the required checks do not exist 12 seconds after the arming push. Three planted controls in `automerge_arming.py --self-test` assert the adopted / PAT / not-told paths still arm.
why: Both halves of #11889 are measured INERT in production and the second was defeated by its own sibling PR. POPULATION: two `claude-pr-automerge` job logs 10.5 hours apart, one from each side of the distinction that matters — run 34718195692 (PR #12087, CREATED by the workflow, 2026-09-12T20:49:21Z) and run 34744864126 (PR #12211, ADOPTED, 2026-09-13T07:17:43Z), both after 4833cc421 merged at 2026-09-12T09:56:31Z. (a) THE PAT HALF HAS NEVER OPENED A PR: both logs read `could not construct a PAT-authenticated client: @actions/github is not resolvable from this script. Falling back to GITHUB_TOKEN`. The secret is present (`PR_OPEN_PAT: ***`); the MODULE is not resolvable from a `github-script` body. #12087's PR object confirms the consequence — `user.login` is `github-actions[bot]`, and its author pushed a second commit 79 seconds later whose message says exactly why. (b) THE ARMING GATE GRADED `attached` ON BOTH RUNS, including on the created-under-GITHUB_TOKEN case it exists to refuse, with the same `why`: `1 check run(s) other than open-and-automerge are attached to this head (watch)`. That run is `watch` from `armed-branch-push-watch.yml` — fires on every `claude/**` push, NOT a required check, and shipped the SAME DAY as the gate as the other half of the same remedy. Auto-merge waits on required checks, so the gate's `something real to wait for` was false about a head that had nothing: UNPROVENANCED DIAGNOSTIC OUTPUT sub-class A, inside the module written to prevent a neighbouring defect. THE FIX: (1) a require-free `fetch` third try in `_patClient()`; (2) `automerge_arming.grade()` takes `opener_kind` and returns a fourth state `opener_cannot_attach`, checked FIRST and not overturnable by any count, never folded into `none_attached` (a run WAS seen; the remedy differs); (3) `check_automerge_trigger.py` gains C8 with two planted defects — 12 of 12 now caught — because C6 was TRUE throughout the period the PAT path was dead, which is the presence-only shape this repo keeps paying for. MEASURED, not asserted: `automerge_arming.py --self-test` passes 26 controls and, with the opener branch deleted, 5 of them fail — including one that asserts the positive state rather than `!= none_attached`, because the weaker form survives the mutation. A node harness exercised the shim end to end (7/7: the two-require-failure path yields a client and does NOT warn; a 201 returns Octokit-shaped `{data}`; a 403 throws carrying `.status`; no global `fetch` returns null and announces the degradation). NOT DONE, deliberately: `pr-opener.yml` is NOT fixed and never had a PAT path at all — measured, with a positive control — so `BL-20260903-A-PR-OPENED-BY-THE-RELAY-CAN-ARM-AUTOMERGE-AND-THEN-WAIT-ON-GREEN-FOREVER` stays open and is annotated rather than closed. Neither existing row is closed by this PR: both criteria demand an OBSERVED attached check on a relay-opened head, and a merge is not an observation.
